gitHistoryCoverage.partial: Large git history: commits analysed since {{date}}. Every new commit is analysed at each scan.
gitHistoryCoverage.none: Git history not analysed (too large or unavailable): only the current code was scanned. Every new commit is analysed at each scan.
gitHistoryCoverage.gaps: Some commits were not analysed, between {{from}} and {{to}}.
gitHistoryCoverage.failed: The last analysis of the git history failed. It is retried at the next scan.
